scope: Ready numerical engine + exact native load inventory + conditional resistive stress; not full EV or hardware qualification
reuse: Existing KiCad ngspice45.2 shared library, analog.cm/xtradev.cm, unmodified TI TLV182x PSpice model; native ledgers/pin reviews, source guards, ProcessRegistry, keep_awake. No new solver, installation or GUI.

ready_model.authority: Typical single-channel family model listed on TLV1824 product page; not exact quad-package, tolerance, leakage or power-off qualification. Vendor model not republished in repository.

timing_scope: Each runs[].seconds is the runner's simulation/replay phase including keep-awake and final source verification; excludes initial source/model/fixture loading, case construction and report writing, so it is not end-to-end CLI wall time.

validation.case_grid: c5/ir x AON2.7/3.3/3.6V x comparator low/high; plus independently known1.65V divider
validation.stimulus: Current resistor nominals at initial -1%, ideal rail/common ground, shorted LED/forward-OR paths, configurable GPIOs assumed input; other branch/leakage/dynamic loads omitted explicitly
validation.fixture_scope: Exactly9 EV endpoints per channel,2 LEDanode and4threshold endpoints,8ANY endpoints and10diode cathode frontier contacts; identities/physicalpads/M1/source provenance checked
validation.interpretation: Conditional model counterexample to assuming0..0.1V without load proof, not a measured physical failure or guaranteed worst-case voltage
validation.fresh_process_reports_equal: All result fields agree except time, PID and local paths; numeric vectors/branch residuals and request/worker hashes match exactly
independent_mutations_rejected: omit shared OR load in actual engine deck
replace LEDseries resistor in actual engine deck
wrong M1 pad, source, supply or MPN

tests.note: Native smoke tests require the local prepared library/archive and explicitly skip without them; no cross-platform availability claim. Production DRC not rerun because no native source changed.

rejected_setup_attempts: Exported ngSpice_nospinit before Init segfaulted in native45.2; not used. Final worker refuses init files and uses a process-local no-spinit search location, without HOME/global changes.
work/ev-spice-bzx_j_dh: native T delay element initially absent from worker allowlist; rejected, then admitted with unit test.
PSpice ps mode covers include files only; documented psa whole-deck mode required for unchanged inline vendor model.
work/ev-spice-02mtqy57: analog.cm alone lacked aswitch; parse failed. Final worker explicitly loads packaged xtradev.cm too, hashes both and passes native VSWITCH control.

primary_source_limits_reviewed.finding: VOL250mV max at4mA/fulltemperature retains12V supply header; output leakage0.1nA is typical, not max. Neither supplies an all-AON-range0.1V guarantee.
Pport leakage rows use VI=VCC/GND; programmable output drive exists. Pin direction metadata does not prove permanent runtime input mode.
Forward voltage at discrete currents and reverse leakage at25V/25C; not adopted as arbitrary whole-temperature low-voltage leakage bounds.

preparation_token_proxy.note: Aggregate goal counter includes unknown cache/agent attribution; not billed or uncached parent tokens. Work after checkpoint excluded. Numerical repeats use no LLM; cloud-token payback remains unmeasured.
